finding: The invoice is account-wide; it cannot be attributed to Twenty without per-database analytics.

twentyOps.note: Production D1 does not currently have the job-failure migrations applied.

conclusion: The large D1 invoice is account-level and is materially driven by sismo911's unindexed hospital_patients normalization query and repeated full scans. Twenty's current production D1 row counts are not sufficient to explain 148.97 USD of D1 usage.

sismo911.topReadQuery: hospital_patients status normalization UPDATE with GROUP BY and correlated subquery
sismo911.secondQuery: COUNT over personas with moderation/protected filters
